mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 50 degrees and clear near the Military Ridge State Trail. The waning gibbous moon is out, and you can catch the International Space Station crossing the sky tonight for 7 minutes, appearing over the high school in the northwest and moving toward Fitchburg at a moderate height.

The city has posted a long list of engineering reports regarding contracts with AECOM Inc. Additionally, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is hosting meetings on November 18 and 19 to discuss design concepts for the US 18/151 corridor between Dodgeville and Fitchburg.

There is plenty to do with Trivia Night and other activities happening today. Tomorrow, be sure to head to Hometown Junction Park for the Main Street Trick or Treat, and check out ART House 360 for their Thursday night events.
On October 25, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where a 40-year-old man was arrested for his first offence of O W I.
It is going to be a great day for a treat because the flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch, and the Culver's of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM.
